india_trends.title: Fertiliser subsidy set to overshoot Budget Estimate of Rs 1.71 lakh crore on costlier imports: Secretary
india_trends.summary: The Fertiliser Association of India has estimated the subsidy at Rs 2.5 lakh crore. Asked if the bill would reach that level, Secretary Rajat Kumar Mishra said the final figure "will increase further" from BE, but the extent depends on how the remaining five months of the fiscal play out.

india_trends.title: China Railway Resources Group bets on Zimbabwe's gold potential with AI mining and $600 million investment plan
india_trends.summary: Zimbabwe-based Duration Gold and China Railway Resources Group signed an agreement to explore a potential $600 million investment in reviving and expanding four gold mines. The proposed partnership would bring financing, engineering expertise and AI-powered mining technology to Vubachikwe, Gaika.

india_trends.title: Gokaldas Exports to Trident: Textile stocks gain up to 8% as global brands turn to India; what's the opportunity?
india_trends.summary: Indian textile shares rose after Reuters reported that global fashion brands shifted garment orders from Bangladesh amid labour unrest and rising costs. India emerged as the main beneficiary, with Gokaldas Exports gaining as much as 11%. Buyers are also considering Vietnam, Cambodia and Indonesia.

india_trends.title: HSBC’s AI-led restructuring: Finance employees in Hyderabad, Pune asked to relocate to three other cities
india_trends.summary: HSBC is consolidating finance support functions across India, with roles in Hyderabad and Pune set to be phased out. Affected employees will be offered relocation support to move to Chennai, Gurugram or Bengaluru, as the lender accelerates its AI-led restructuring.

india_trends.title: Jaipur leads jewellery searches with 78% growth, Delhi tops gold testing centre searches at 58%, says report
india_trends.summary: Searches for jewellery showrooms in India rose 53% year-on-year, while searches for gold testing centres and buyers increased 36% and 34%, respectively, according to Justdial. The trends suggest consumers are exploring purchases, purity checks and resale or exchange options amid rising gold prices.

india_trends.title: India bonds slump as oil spike adds to RBI hike bets
india_trends.summary: Indian government bonds experienced a decline this week, largely influenced by rising oil prices and US Treasury yields. The benchmark bond yield reached its highest point in a week at 7.2650% on Friday. Analysts are anticipating a potential increase in interest rates from the Reserve Bank of India
